facts.statement: The species Albertosuchus knudsenii was named in 2015 based on fossils found in the Scollard Formation of Alberta.
facts.quote: The type species Albertosuchus knudsenii was named in 2015 from the Scollard Formation in Alberta.

facts.statement: Albertosuchus lived in Canada during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Albertosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyloid crocodylian from the Late Cretaceous of Canada.

facts.statement: Albertosuchus is the northernmost Late Cretaceous crocodylian known from North America.
facts.quote: Albertosuchus is the northernmost-known Late Cretaceous crocodylian in North America.

facts.statement: The classification of Albertosuchus as a close relative of Arenysuchus is considered uncertain due to the incomplete nature of the known fossil material.
facts.quote: although the incomplete nature of known material makes these findings uncertain

facts.statement: Albertosuchus lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian stage.
